title: Kid Icarus: Of Myths and Monsters

info.about: Kid Icarus: Of Myths and Monsters is a 1991 action-platform game developed and published by Nintendo for the Game Boy. It is a sequel to Kid Icarus (1986) for the Nintendo Entertainment System.
info.why: Released only in North America and Europe in 1991–92 and not sold in Japan until the 3DS Virtual Console; it has never been reprinted on cartridge.
